```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# 1. 读取并清洗数据
retail <- read.csv("~/Desktop/retail-price-optimization/retail_price.csv")

retail_clean <- retail %>%
  mutate(min_comp_price = pmin(comp_1, comp_2, comp_3, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(qty), qty > 0,
    !is.na(unit_price), unit_price > 0,
    !is.na(min_comp_price), min_comp_price > 0,
    !is.na(customers), customers > 0
  )

# 2. 定义单个 SKU 的 Bootstrap 95% 置信区间函数
calc_bootstrap_ci <- function(df_sub, p_curr, p_rec, q_base, n_boot = 2000) {
  if (nrow(df_sub) < 5) {
    return(c(NA, NA))
  }
  set.seed(42)
  rev_curr <- p_curr * q_base

  boot_gains <- replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample(1:nrow(df_sub), size = nrow(df_sub), replace = TRUE)
    boot_df <- df_sub[idx, ]

    # 抽样后单价或竞品价没有波动则跳过
    if (length(unique(boot_df$unit_price)) < 2) {
      return(NA)
    }
    if (length(unique(boot_df$min_comp_price)) < 2) {
      return(NA)
    }

    m <- tryCatch(
      lm(log(qty) ~ log(unit_price) + log(min_comp_price) + log(customers), data = boot_df),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(m)) {
      return(NA)
    }

    b_boot <- coef(m)["log(unit_price)"]
    if (is.na(b_boot)) {
      return(NA)
    }

    q_new <- q_base * (p_rec / p_curr)^b_boot
    (p_rec * q_new) - rev_curr
  })

  boot_gains <- boot_gains[!is.na(boot_gains)]
  if (length(boot_gains) < 100) {
    return(c(NA, NA))
  }

  as.numeric(quantile(boot_gains, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)))
}

# 3. 逐个商品计算弹性、推荐价格和置信区间
products <- unique(retail_clean$product_id)
results_list <- list()

for (pid in products) {
  df_sub <- retail_clean %>% filter(product_id == pid)
  if (nrow(df_sub) < 5) {
    next
  }

  # 拟合需求弹性模型
  model <- tryCatch(
    lm(log(qty) ~ log(unit_price) + log(min_comp_price) + log(customers), data = df_sub),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(model)) {
    next
  }

  coef_table <- summary(model)$coefficients
  if (!("log(unit_price)" %in% rownames(coef_table))) {
    next
  }

  elasticity      <- coef_table["log(unit_price)", "Estimate"]
  pval_elasticity <- coef_table["log(unit_price)", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  if (is.na(elasticity)) {
    next
  }

  # 当前基准价格与销量
  current_price <- mean(df_sub$unit_price, na.rm = TRUE)
  current_qty   <- mean(df_sub$qty, na.rm = TRUE)

  # 在当前价格上下 20% 范围内寻找预期营收最高的价格作为推荐价
  price_grid        <- seq(current_price * 0.8, current_price * 1.2, length.out = 50)
  expected_revs     <- price_grid * current_qty * (price_grid / current_price)^elasticity
  recommended_price <- price_grid[which.max(expected_revs)]

  # 计算预期变化与竞品中位价
  expected_qty       <- current_qty * (recommended_price / current_price)^elasticity
  demand_change_pct  <- ((expected_qty - current_qty) / current_qty) * 100
  current_revenue    <- current_price * current_qty
  expected_revenue   <- recommended_price * expected_qty
  revenue_diff       <- expected_revenue - current_revenue
  revenue_change_pct <- (revenue_diff / current_revenue) * 100
  comp_price         <- median(df_sub$min_comp_price, na.rm = TRUE)

  # 计算 Bootstrap 置信区间
  ci      <- calc_bootstrap_ci(df_sub, current_price, recommended_price, current_qty, n_boot = 2000)
  ci_low  <- round(ci[1], 0)
  ci_high <- round(ci[2], 0)

  # 自动生成风险标签
  risk_level <- case_when(
    !is.na(ci_low) & ci_low > 0 & pval_elasticity < 0.05 ~ "Low Risk",
    !is.na(ci_low) & ci_low > 0                          ~ "Moderate Risk",
    TRUE                                                 ~ "High Risk"
  )

  results_list[[as.character(pid)]] <- data.frame(
    product_id         = pid,
    current_price      = round(current_price, 2),
    recommended_price  = round(recommended_price, 2),
    elasticity         = round(elasticity, 3),
    pval_elasticity    = round(pval_elasticity, 4),
    current_qty        = round(current_qty, 1),
    expected_qty       = round(expected_qty, 1),
    demand_change_pct  = round(demand_change_pct, 2),
    current_revenue    = round(current_revenue, 2),
    expected_revenue   = round(expected_revenue, 2),
    revenue_diff       = round(revenue_diff, 2),
    revenue_change_pct = round(revenue_change_pct, 2),
    comp_price         = round(comp_price, 2),
    ci_low             = ci_low,
    ci_high            = ci_high,
    risk_level         = risk_level
  )
}

final_dashboard_data <- bind_rows(results_list)
head(final_dashboard_data)
```
